title: Computational investigation of missense somatic mutations in cancer and potential links to pH-dependence and proteostasis
one_liner_zh: 该文研究癌症体细胞错义突变与pH依赖及蛋白质稳态的关联，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Metabolic changes during tumour development lead to acidification of the extracellular environment and a smaller increase of intracellular pH. Searches for somatic missense mutations that could reveal adaptation to altered pH have focussed on arginine to histidine changes, part of a general arginine depletion that originates from DNA mutational mechanisms. Analysis of mutations to histidine, potentially a simple route to the introduction of pH-sensing, shows no clear biophysical separation overall of subsets that are more and less frequently mutated in cancer genomes. Within the more frequently mutated subset, individual sites predicted to mediate pH-dependence upon mutation include NDST1 (a Golgi-resident heparan sulphate modifying enzyme), the HLA-C chain of MHCI complex, and the water channel AQP-7. Arginine depletion is a general feature that persists in the more frequently mutated subset, and is complemented by over-representation of mutations to lysine. Arginine to lysine balance is a known factor in determining protein solubility, with higher lysine content being more favourable. Proteins with greater change in arginine to lysine balance are enriched for cell periphery location, where proteostasis is likely to be challenged in tumour cells. Somatic missense mutations in a cancer genome number only in the 10s typically, although can be much higher. Whether the altered arginine to lysine balance is of sufficient scale to play a role in tumour development is unknown.
abstract_zh: 肿瘤发展过程中的代谢变化导致细胞外环境酸化，以及细胞内pH值的较小幅度升高。针对可能揭示对pH变化适应的体细胞错义突变的搜索，集中于精氨酸到组氨酸的改变，这是源于DNA突变机制的普遍精氨酸耗竭的一部分。对组氨酸突变（可能是引入pH感应的一条简单途径）的分析显示，在癌症基因组中，总体上没有明显的生物物理分离，区分出突变频率较高和较低的亚群。在突变频率较高的亚群中，预测突变后介导pH依赖性的个别位点包括NDST1（一种高尔基体驻留的硫酸乙酰肝素修饰酶）、MHCI复合体的HLA-C链，以及水通道AQP-7。精氨酸耗竭是突变频率较高亚群中持续存在的一个普遍特征，并且伴随着赖氨酸突变过度代表的补充。精氨酸与赖氨酸的平衡是决定蛋白质溶解性的已知因素，其中较高的赖氨酸含量更为有利。精氨酸与赖氨酸平衡变化较大的蛋白质富集于细胞外周位置，而在此处，肿瘤细胞中的蛋白质稳态可能面临挑战。癌症基因组中的体细胞错义突变通常仅以数十计，尽管也可能更高。精氨酸与赖氨酸平衡的改变是否达到足以在肿瘤发展中发挥作用的规模，目前尚不清楚。
